question_text: A flute player produces a flute in a location where the speed of sound in air is 330 m/s$^1$ when the note A is played, it occurs exactly at 440 Hz. If the tuning fork of this flute is sounded simultaneously with the same note A produced by another flute at a location where the speed of sound is 333 m/s$^1$, where the speed of sound in air is 333 m/s$^1$, a flute beat frequency of 440 Hz will be produced. What will be the flute beat frequency?
